abstract: Mouse embryocarcinoma stem cells differentiate in culture, given the appropriate induction. We examined whether these cells could provide information about the regulation of nucleotide excision repair in relation to differentiation by measuring the rate-limiting incision step, the removal of cyclobutane dimers and (6-4) photoproducts from the genome as a whole and the effect of the bacteriophage T4 endonuclease (denV) gene on repair in differentiated cells. It was found that differentiation is accompanied by a marked decline in the early incision ability after UV irradiation (sixfold for P19, fourfold for PCC7 and twofold for F9), and we measured, in parallel, the loss of two common UV photoproducts [cyclobutane dimers and (6-4) photoproducts] from P19 cells. After differentiation, the excellent overall cyclobutane dimer repair capacity of proliferating cells (84% removal in 24 h) is lost (no removal in 24 h), while removal of (6-4) photoproducts, although normal at 24 h (94%), is much slower than in undifferentiated P19 at 3 h (no removal versus 64%). The presence of the denV gene greatly stimulates the repair of cyclobutane dimers in undifferentiated P19 cells (94% removal at 3 h versus 40%) and also in differentiated cells (50% removal at 24 h versus no removal). The denV gene also stimulates the early repair of (6-4) photoproducts in both differentiated and undifferentiated cells.
abstract_ja: マウス胎児性癌幹細胞は、適切な誘導により培養下で分化する。本研究では、これらの細胞が分化に伴うヌクレオチド除去修復の制御について情報を提供できるかを検討した。律速段階であるincisionステップ、すなわちゲノム全体からのシクロブタン二量体および(6-4)光産物の除去、ならびに細菌ファージT4エンドヌクレアーゼ(denV)遺伝子の分化細胞における修復への影響を測定した。分化に伴い、紫外線照射後の初期incision能が著しく低下することが判明した(P19で6倍、PCC7で4倍、F9で2倍)。並行して、P19細胞から2種の一般的な紫外線光産物(シクロブタン二量体と(6-4)光産物)の消失を測定した。分化後には、増殖細胞に優れたシクロブタン二量体の修復能(24時間で84%除去)が失われ(24時間で除去なし)、一方で(6-4)光産物の除去は24時間では正常(94%)であったが、未分化P19の3時間(除去なし対64%)と比べてはるかに遅かった。denV遺伝子の存在は、未分化P19細胞のシクロブタン二量体の修復を大きく促進し(3時間で94%除去対40%)、分化細胞でも促進した(24時間で50%除去対除去なし)。denV遺伝子は、分化細胞と未分化細胞の両方において(6-4)光産物の初期修復も促進した。
